confidence_notes: I based the restaurant, coffee and beer anchors on web searches of aggregated cost-of-living sites (Numbeo Nov 2026, Wise 2026, Hikersbay), and they mostly agree. Inexpensive meals are about $11, a mid-range meal for two is $45 to $50, cappuccino is $3.20 to $4.99 and a domestic draft beer is about $4. I didn't search directly for cocktail or wine prices. I estimated those from their usual relationship to beer and Mendoza's position as a wine region, where a glass of house Malbec is relatively cheap. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates from general knowledge, not from searches or listings, so they are the least certain. Argentina's high inflation and changing exchange rate make July 2026 USD prices volatile.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared against Córdoba and Buenos Aires, where Mendoza is a little cheaper than Buenos Aires. Accommodation was benchmarked against mid-sized Argentine tourist cities with strong wine-tourism demand.
